Academic Staff

Home About Us About University
01

Chairman of the Board of Trustees

Andrew Wachtel

Chairman of the Board of Trustees BA from Harvard University; MA and PhD in Slavic Languages from the University of California, Berkeley. Former Chair of the Slavic Department and Dean of the Graduate School at Northwestern University. Served for eight years as President of the American University of Central Asia. Rector of Narxoz University (Kazakhstan).
02

Co-founder and CEO of TEAM University

Hikmat Abdurahmanov

BSc and MSc in International Economics from the University of World Economy and Diplomacy (Tashkent); MSc in International Business from the University of the West of England (UK); Executive Course for business owners at SKOLKOVO Moscow School of Management. Taught Strategic Management as an assistant professor and visiting faculty member. Has developed 15 business case studies and leads TEAM’s Case Club.

Welcome message

A Message from the Chair & CEO

“At TEAM University, we believe that education should create opportunities, inspire ambition and prepare people to make a meaningful impact. Our goal is to build a dynamic academic community where students, faculty and partners can learn, innovate and grow together.

Andrew Wachtel
